description_ru: Alluvial fans and aprons: gravel and sand; > 5-10 m
Colluvial blanket and veneer: rubble, gravel, sand; includes rock outcrop
Slump deposits: bedrock rubble and diamicton; > 5 m
Eolian deposits: sand with minor silt; 1-4 m; parabolic and blowout dunes
Lacustrine plain (glacial Lake McConnell): silt, sand, minor clay; > 1.5 m; thermokarst
Lacustrine veneer: silt and sand; < 1.5 m over till
Glaciofluvial plains and terraces: gravel and sand; 3-10 m
Glaciofluvial hummocks and ridges (ice contact): sand, gravel; > 3 m
Hummocky and ridged moraine: till; > 5 m
Moraine plain (flat, rolling, drumlinized): silt and clay-matrix till; > 1.5 m
Rock: undifferentiated sedimentary rock, weathered or colluvium-covered
